provenance.database: isolated in-memory SQLite; no production/default DB connection
provenance.catalogue: existing _seed_exercise_catalog; canonical exercise muscle links, no independent counting engine

states.populated: Recorded completed workouts, canonical metadata; no missing-metadata sets.
states.incomplete: Same recorded history plus two working sets in an exercise with zero muscle links.
states.empty: No completed workouts or sets in either period.
states.all_unmapped: Three recorded workouts; six completed sets in an exercise with zero muscle links.
